m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: The Astral Primordial Trees should be here somewhere in this Grove.
We'll follow your lead, Wizard. Count us in!
We yield! I beg you, Wizard. Put me out of my misery. I can't bear to face the destruction you and the Shadow will wreak.
Geez, you Luphilim sure are over the top sometimes. We're all on the same team here.
Raven-Child! This unlikely triumvirate confuses me. But at this juncture, I trust in you and the Wizard more than my master, Raven.
Good, 'cuz Mother's lost her perspective. The three of us fight together - for the Spiral. We could really use your help...
This goes beyond treason, but I see no other way to live to regret it; the Luphilim's swords are yours. I will inform the others. Jehoha'ninquo.
OK, Wizard, now use your sacred Water to wake up those Trees so Mellori can teach them a Lullaby... heh.
OK, so the Wizard is going to wake 'em up, and then I just... uh... I have no idea what to do!
Just focus on the part of you that was once part of Raven. Find her memories of hearing the Lullaby. Then, just be you. I know you can do this.
Astral Trees, listen and tune your immortal voices to me as we sing the Titanic Lullaby!
Oooo waaaahh oooo!
It worked! Come on, team, on to the next Grove.
That's one Grove of three secured, but the Astral Trees' singing is being drowned out by the din of the melee coming from the Astral Grove.
Mercifully, the opposing Myth energy of the Chain intermittently weakens him, but the Heart won't withstand such a beating for long.
Worse yet, Raven's Luphilim and all of Spider's Shadow sycophants have descended upon the Forest and are vying for the Heart as well.
It's a supernatural free-for-all! Subduing a turbo-charged Titan won't be easy. This is going to take one formidable plan of attack.
All it will take is for each one of you to realize your true purpose. And the backing of the Primordial Trees.
They were my companions in the First World. They've remained frozen here, petrified by the horror of the First World's destruction.
All trees keep within themselves a record of dramatic changes to their environment. You simply have to know how to access those records.
Each Grove of Primordial Trees heard a unique section of the Titanic Lullaby - the song that first put the Titans to sleep.
I'm still too weak to sing it by myself. That's why you must conduct the Primordial Trees in singing the Titanic Lullaby.
How in the literal name of Creation are we going to do that?
My Scion possesses that which can awaken the Trees from their slumber: the Water from the Springs Eternal! As for the song, Mellori is the key.
Ugh! I thought we covered this already?! Sorry for the tone, Uncle B., but we gotta speed up the tempo here. Can you skip to the point, please?
Haha. Your tone is precisly the point, Mellori. You know you are Raven's love for Spider. Well, that love set the tone for this world.
Don't you see, my dear girl? In the great Symphony of Existence, you are the <ITALICS>key</ITALICS> in which all divine melodies are played.
Oh. Well alright then.
This rendition of the Lullaby won't be as powerful as the last, but it should calm the Storm Titan enough for you to remove him from the Chain.
Well then, I suppose we've got some destinies to fulfill. C'mon, Bat, let's stake out the first Astral Grove. Meet us there, Wizard!
My Scion, use the Eternal Water to revive the three Groves of Primordial Trees. And, of course, watch over Bat and Mellori.
Use the Water you collected from the Springs Eternal to revive the petrified Primordial Trees so Mellori can tune them to the Titanic Lullaby.
